## Problem

What are you trying to do that the server doesn't support today? Describe the
use case, not just the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see: a new tool, an option, a behavior change. If it relies
on an IMAP extension, name it and link its RFC.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about, and why they fall short.

## Scope

- [ ] Read-only (nothing changes in the mailbox)
- [ ] Write operation (sends, moves, flags, deletes or creates messages)

## Additional context

Anything else: examples, links.
